sections.heading: 1. Bridge with a cushion squeeze
lines: ① Lie down, knees bent, cushion between knees.
② Squeeze gently and lift your hips.
③ Hold 3 sec × 10 reps, 2–3 times a week.
④ Getting easy? Try it on one leg, slowly.

caption:
Lulu plays footy every weekend, and the back of his thigh keeps grabbing when he sprints. ⚽

Hamstrings often strain at speed, right as the muscle lengthens. Kicking and changing direction also lean on the inner thigh, and both cop it more when training load jumps in pre-season.

Hybi's tip: bridge with a cushion squeeze, 3 seconds, 10 reps, 2–3 times a week. Clinical Pilates usually works well as an add-on to your running and gym work, not a swap.

A sharp grab mid-sprint, bruising or groin pain that keeps coming back is worth an assessment first. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio works alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio.
